title: FLA import: Scene 5 imports 2 frames / 'menu' label on frame 2 — should be 1 frame / frame 1
description:
REOPENED — this is a REAL parser over-count bug (NOT "faithful import", as the prior
done-state and commit 99447d1 wrongly concluded). USER GROUND TRUTH (has real Flash 8):
Magnet.fla Scene 5 'Ball' layer shows EXACTLY ONE frame in Flash, with the 'menu' label +
stop() + content on FRAME 1. Our importer produces TWO frames (a leading EMPTY keyframe at
index 0 + menu/content at index 1), inventing a PHANTOM leading frame and pushing 'menu' to
UI frame 2 / inflating the scene span to 2.

ROOT CAUSE (file:line + byte evidence) — the on-wire CPicFrame DURATION field is ZERO for
the phantom, and the parser CLAMPS it to 1:
  packages/core/src/fla/flash8-binary.ts:2909  `duration = Math.max(1, r.u16());`
A CPicFrame whose serialized u16 duration == 0 is a degenerate / non-advancing leading
marker that real Flash 8 collapses (the very next real keyframe occupies frame index 0).
`Math.max(1, ...)` turns it into a phantom 1-frame keyframe; then the import
(flash8-import.ts ~1357-1376, `createFrame(frameIndex,...)` with `frameIndex += f.duration`)
emits it as a standalone empty keyframe at index 0 and shifts the real content to index 1.

BYTE EVIDENCE (Page 5 stream, traced via instrumented dist parser):
  Ball layer @0x155 (CPicObjBase schema=2 flags=0; first child CPicFrame backref 0x8005 @0x159):
    frame[0] @0x159: ObjBase children=0 (EMPTY); frame-tail fs=23 @0x18c, then duration u16
                     @0x18d = 0x0000 -> rawDuration=0 -> clamped to 1; label="" script=""
                     elements=0; frameId 0x3337; record ends @0x1e0. (the leading PHANTOM)
    frame[1] @0x1e2: ObjBase children=3 (Symbol 2 + Symbol 9 + static text); frame-tail fs=23
                     @0x720, duration u16 @0x721 = 0x0001 = 1; label='menu' (BomString @0x738),
                     script='stop()' (BomString @0x754); record ends @0x788. (the REAL frame)
  EVERY other CPicFrame in the whole file stores its real duration as-is (1, or e.g. 53 for a
  span) — duration is stored as N, NOT N-1 — so 0 is genuinely a zero-span/degenerate record,
  not a 1-frame keyframe. The prior investigation (99447d1) correctly located both label
  BomStrings but WRONGLY concluded "two records => two keyframes => faithful": it never
  inspected the duration field; the leading record's duration is 0.

SCOPE — GENERAL OVER-COUNT, not Ball/Scene-5-only. Scanning all 68 timeline streams
(parseFla8Timeline) found 939 CPicFrame records, of which 28 have rawDuration==0, spread
across Page 5/6/7/8 and Symbol 18/19/34/59. Two positional kinds:
  (a) LEADING-empty phantoms (the confirmed bug): e.g. Page 6 Layer 6 / masked Layer 5 /
      Magnets / Walls / Ball ALL start with a dur=0 empty record. This inflates each layer by
      one frame AND shifts every subsequent label: Page 6 'Magnets' carries labels BA1..BA14
      that are all off-by-one; corrected counts: Magnets 54->53, Walls 50->49, Ball 54->53.
      It ALSO misaligns masks: Page 6 mask 'Layer 5' (type=4) has its content on frame 1
      (dur=53, NO phantom) while its masked children start at frame 2 -> 1-frame mask
      misregistration (a real render defect, not cosmetic).
  (b) TRAILING-empty dur=0 records that END a span (e.g. Symbol 19 'Colors (Stationary)'
      [0]dur=3 el=1, [1]dur=1 el=0 dur0). These also got clamped; the fix must handle the
      trailing case correctly (it likely is/ends a blank keyframe) and NOT blindly drop every
      dur=0 record. Severity is therefore HIGH (widespread index/label/mask inflation), and
      the fix needs positional care, not a global "skip dur==0".

WRONG TEST PIN — commit 99447d1 ('test(fla-import): pin Scene 5 import to raw
parseFla8Timeline ground truth') rewrote packages/core/src/fla/__tests__/magnet-inspect.test.ts
to ASSERT the 2-frame output (Ball frames.length===2, scene span===2, menu at raw idx 1,
leading empty kf at idx 0). This is CIRCULAR — it validates the parser against itself and
PINS THE BUG. The fix MUST flip this test to expect Ball=1 frame with 'menu' on frame 1
(model index 0), span 1; do NOT treat the current pinned 2-frame expectation as ground truth.

FIX DIRECTION (do NOT just clamp): a CPicFrame with on-wire duration==0 at the START of a
layer must not create a standalone keyframe — the following real keyframe takes index 0.
Likely: change flash8-binary.ts:2909 to preserve the real (possibly 0) duration and have the
import (flash8-import.ts convertTimeline ~1357-1376) skip/merge a leading duration-0 empty
record rather than emitting it + advancing frameIndex; verify the trailing-empty dur=0 case
(Symbol 19) still imports its intended keyframe. Acceptance is Ruffle/visual + the corrected
magnet-inspect assertions, NOT byte-presence. Re-verify mask alignment in Page 6 after fix.
